title: Why Do Mosquitoes Bite Some People More?
short_title: Why mosquitoes bite some people more
description: Why do mosquitoes bite some people more than others? The simple science of breath, heat and skin smell.
comment: Do mosquitoes love you or ignore you? Tell me below!

scenes.text: Why do mosquitoes bite some people more than others?
First, they smell your breath. Mosquitoes can sense the carbon dioxide you breathe out from far away.
They also sense body heat, and the smell of your skin, made by your skin and the tiny microbes living on it.
Everyone's skin smell is different. Studies show some people are simply more attractive to mosquitoes, and genes may play a part.
People who breathe out more, like after exercise, may get found more easily. Dark clothes can also be easier for them to spot.
So cover up, use a net or repellent, and remove standing water around your home.
